east-blue-design-system/.d: Monorepo: the Astro documentation site, the build and review workflows, and the scripts that check them.

east-blue-design-system/CLAUDE.md.d: Session rules loaded into every run: the trigger phrases (Build + Review per tab, plus Component Update), Rule Zero, the read-only Figma rule, where things live, and git / deploy.

east-blue-design-system/eb-ds-assessment.d: The method: what the scores mean. 4 DS Health traits, ratings, verdicts, criteria C1–C6 (C7 deferred), native status incl. Fix = needs a fix to pass, and GCash patterns. Rendered at /eb-ds-assessment-guide.

east-blue-design-system/workflows/.d: How an assessment is run. build/ writes a tab, review/ rechecks it. The shared README holds setup, house rules and reading Figma for both.

east-blue-design-system/workflows/README.d: Shared by Build and Review: setup, house rules, reading and editing Figma, run order, field map, status vocabulary (Done / Partial / Missing / Broken) and the decisions log.

east-blue-design-system/workflows/build/.d: Writing a tab: one build guide per tab, plus the Component Update rollout. Each build ends by running its review guide’s checks.
Build or review? When to use each, how a build runs, and the build order for a new component.

The rollout for a component already on the site: Playground, In Context and the sweep cleanup in one run. Mechanical changes only; every judgement call is reported for the owner, not made. The first 20 Core Components went through it.
Component name. The AI finds the page and its Figma set.
update:check — is the Figma set live and healthy? Stops if not; update:trace finds a set that moved.
Playground, then In Context (update:context exports the screen), then the sweep cleanup (update:tidy).
Runs every check and writes the report for the owner.
Commit to your own branch, open a PR to main with the report. Never push to main.
Writes the Overview tab: the six sections, plain-language rules, traits, issues, recommendations, verdict box and badges. Also holds the Property Naming Guidelines.
Name, Figma link, channel. Creates the data file for a new component.
Reads the property panel, layers, tokens, states and assets. Sorts findings into the four decision buckets; asks when something may be intentional.
Rates the 4 traits, writes open issues (headline + body + C1–C6 tag), recommendations (ten tags), Behavior, the verdict box, and matching badges.
Runs the {checks:OVERVIEW-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks from OVERVIEW-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.
Generates the Playground from the Figma component set and passes the four checks.
Name + Figma link of the component set, not one variant.
npm run playground:build writes public/playground/<slug>.json. Never hand-edited. Needs FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN.
Look at it against Figma, then smoke → reflow → a11y → fidelity. Fidelity reading and known rendering bugs included.
Runs the {checks:PLAYGROUND-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks from PLAYGROUND-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.
Writes the Code tab: the seven sections, installation coordinates and the family table, mapping format, component API snippets.
Name, Figma link, channel. Stops on remove / consolidate / product-layer.
Property worksheet from the Figma panel, slots included, plus the variant total and its multiplier.
Installation → Property Mapping → Usage Snippets → Accessibility → Usage Guidelines → Scorecard C1–C6 → Variants Inventory. Every change shown previous → new.
Runs the {checks:CODE-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks from CODE-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.
Writes one new changelog entry. Run last.
Name, Figma link, channel.
Four sources: git history, Overview moves, live Figma, this session’s runs. All six buckets checked.
One entry, newest first, bump sized to the change. Never edits a past entry.
Runs the {checks:CHANGELOG-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks from CHANGELOG-REVIEW-GUIDE.md.

east-blue-design-system/workflows/review.d: Rechecking a tab that exists: baseline, recheck with small fixes, then the checks. Anything bigger goes to the tab’s build guide.
Rechecks an existing Overview tab against live Figma. Small fixes only; writing the tab is Component Build.
Name, Figma link and plugin channel code. Stops if there is no data file (that is a Component Build).
Prints four tables verbatim from the JSON: Open Issues, Resolved, Design Recos, Applied.
Checks each item against live Figma one at a time. Small fixes: move fixed items to Resolved / Applied, add new findings, re-rate traits, sync verdict and badges, delete C7.
{checks:OVERVIEW-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks: build, four traits, verdict matches traits, badges match, no C7, issue shape, reco tags, behavior table, description rule.
Rechecks a Playground that already exists. The only fix is a rebuild through Playground Build.
Name + Figma link of the component set. Stops if public/playground/<slug>.json does not exist (that is a Playground Build).
Prints set id, variant count, properties, build date and tokens source, then runs playground:drift.
Rebuilds when drift says changed / edited / unbuilt. Lists component findings (C1–C6) for the Overview tab.

{checks:PLAYGROUND-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks: drift current, data generated, whole set, properties complete, smoke, reflow, a11y, fidelity ≤1%, cross-browser, tokens named, wrong-family tokens, faces, lint, build.
Rechecks an existing Code tab against Figma and the Code Build rules. Type "Code Tab Review" if the built-in /code-review diff review fires instead.
Name, Figma link, channel. Stops on remove / consolidate / product-layer, or if there is no Code tab yet.
Property worksheet with slots, total variant count and its multiplier, section inventory.
Compares every section by tier. Small fixes: stale names and counts, mapping format, install coordinates, footnotes, syntax spans, section order. Each shown previous → new.
{checks:CODE-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks: section order, planned install at 1.0.0, mapping grouped and complete, no container code, mapping and snippets agree, variant total, no footnotes, syntax spans.
Rechecks the audit trail: is every change recorded and is history intact?
Name, Figma link, channel.
Prints existing entries, then gathers the evidence the same way Changelog Build does.
Compares entries against the evidence. Small fixes: one backfill patch entry for a missed change, newest-first order, restore an edited past entry.
{checks:CHANGELOG-REVIEW-GUIDE.md} checks: order, bump, Month YYYY date, file and node cited, a row per resolved issue and applied reco, history not rewritten, doc work recorded.
The page with sample content: every section, its expected content, and the situations a reviewer meets.
The framework audit, its thirteen decisions and the fix pass.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/.d: The static documentation site and every script that measures it.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/packa.d: Defines the npm commands the guides and CI run.

npm:build.d: astro build. Catches schema breakage. Run after every data edit.

npm:lint.d: Preview structure + colors-table coverage + Playground lint.

npm:audit.d: framework-sweep: every component against every guide rule.

npm:audit:gate.d: Same sweep; exits 1 if any component fails a structural rule.

npm:check.d: build + audit:gate + lint. What CI runs on every pull request.

npm:update:check.d: Component Update step: is the page pointing at a live, healthy Figma set?

npm:update:trace.d: Finds where a component set lives now when update:check says it moved.

npm:update:context.d: Exports the "In Context" screen frame from Figma as the page’s image.

npm:update:tidy.d: The mechanical Code-tab sweep fixes: drop the install footnote, add syntax spans.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/src/c.d: The CMS files and the source of truth. One JSON per component ({components}).
The only content file a review run edits. Holds meta, overview, style, code and changelog.
Reference page: the whole framework on sample data, held to all 31 rules. Hidden from nav. Never cite its values.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/src/d.d: Shared databases the reviews match against.
Every library variable. Generated by scripts/tokens/import.mjs, never hand-edited.
DS text-style database and matchLayer(): resolves a text layer to its DS style name.
Space, negative space, radius and elevation from the Primitives collection.
The ComponentData schema. Maintainer only; never edited in a review run.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/publi.d: Per-component live preview script. With <slug>.json, the only files a review run may edit.
Generated Playground layer data. Output of playground:build.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/scrip.d: The automation.
Measurement and lint. Reports only, never edits.
The measurement: every component × every guide rule. Powers audit, audit:matrix and audit:gate.
REST read of a node: bound spacing, colour, radius and shadow resolved to token names.
npm run lint:previews.
npm run lint:colors.
npm run lint:playground.
Spec-card completion report (audit:progress).
Markdown table of every live preview, for the preview-vs-Figma audit.
Scans prose fields for patterns the copywriting rules name. Reports only.
The Component Update scripts. Read-only against Figma (file_content:read token).
Reads meta.node and asks Figma what is there. Stops at anything that needs a person: a missing node, an empty set.
Given any instance of the component, reports the set it uses — how a moved set is found.
Exports an "In Context – …" frame from the Working File’s Pipeline page as the page’s In Context image.
The mechanical Code-tab sweep fixes: K9 drops the install footnote, K10 adds syntax spans to every usage snippet.
Shared Figma REST helpers for the update scripts. Every call is a read (GET).
Build and gate the Playground.
Script list: what each playground script does and its npm command. The step-by-step build is Playground Build in workflows/build/.
Figma REST → layer tree per variant, tokens resolved, vectors exported as SVG. Needs FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN.
current / may-differ / changed / edited / unbuilt. --deep re-reads and compares hashes.
Every control, layer and code language renders with no error or clipping.
Every variant × boolean combination obeys Figma auto-layout.
Names, WAI-ARIA tree pattern, focus ring, live region.
Figma PNG export vs rendered Playground, pixel for pixel.
Regenerates src/data/tokens.json from the library variables.
Captures JS-rendered previews and writes them back into each component JSON.
Fetches one Figma PNG per component and spec card for visual comparison.
Side-by-side HTML of Figma references vs visual baselines.

east-blue-design-system/screen-normaliza.d: Screen consistency work, separate from component assessment: the Dashboard-baseline guideline, the standard, and the draft token spec they use.
How to normalize screens to the Dashboard baseline: process, principles, density profiles, the rules, a per-item checklist, severity and verdict.
Completes the screen standard: a severity + exception schema for the machine pass, a human review rubric, the combined screen verdict and the radius rules.

Foundations tokens as a JSON spec in the W3C Design Tokens format: spacing, layout, typography, colour roles, radius, elevation and the $rules validation checks. Marked as a draft: values are proposals, not read from Figma; tokens.json is the source of truth.

east-blue-design-system/.github/workflow.d: CI that runs the automation without a reviewer.
npm ci → build → audit:gate → audit → lint on every pull request and push.
Playwright visual tests against the stored baselines.
Builds and runs the Playground fidelity check on chromium, firefox and webkit.
Deploys to production. Why nothing is committed without being told.
Builds and deploys to GitHub Pages.

east-blue-design-system/astro-site/scrip.d: Builds the two status pages from the repo and Figma: the Component Reusability Report data and this Workflow Tree. Read-only against Figma.
Component Reusability Report data: every component’s rating, status and verdict from its JSON, its group and status from the Figma checklists, and whether it differs from main.
This tree: guides, npm scripts, automation and CI read from the repo, described from tree-notes.json.
The hand-written descriptions this tree shows. A file without a note is described from its own first line.

npm:report.d: Builds both status pages’ data: report:status then report:tree.
